findings.description: Independently parsed pinned directory bytes (hashes match packet): roster /people/faculty has 109 entries = all 109 required people and expected_primary_profile_urls; core /people/faculty/ece has 83; the 26 roster-only people are the 22 Affiliate Faculty page entries plus the 4 Adjunct Faculty page entries. Titles agree across every list in which a person appears. Shared frozen captures reviewed; no fresh download was made.

22 non-core people appear on the official ECE Affiliate Faculty page with university professor/associate/assistant professor titles (primary appointments in CS, ME, BME, Aerospace, Statistics/Data Sciences, Speech-Language-Hearing, etc.): included as affiliate_professor under the user-approved official-ECE-affiliate rule: Adela Ben-Yakar, Andrew Dunn, Calvin Lin, Don Fussell, Donglei "Emma" Fan, Inderjit Dhillon, James Tunnell, Javad Mohammadi, Jun Wang, Keshav Pingali, Kristen Grauman, Lili Qiu, Mark F Hamilton, Michael Cullinan, Mingyuan Zhou, Peter Stone, Preston Wilson, Samantha Santacruz, Todd Humphreys, Ufuk Topcu, Warren Hunt Jr, Yuebing Zheng.

4 non-core people are on the official Adjunct Faculty page with adjunct titles and profile text ("adjunct professor in the Chandra Family Department of ECE"): excluded as adjunct: Alan Bovik, Alex Dimakis, Christine Julien, Sriram Vishwanath.
In the /ece core list and on the Affiliate Faculty page; official profile states courtesy appointments in ECE. Recorded as explicit courtesy (included); not a regular ECE appointment.

Profile states he has been on leave since May 2024 as Research Director at XTX Markets; the directory still lists him as an Associate Professor in the core list, so he is retained as a current regular professor. Leave status does not change category.

Professor of Practice (4) and Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor of Instruction (6) are recorded in the closed excluded category teaching per the policy brief ("teaching/practice/instruction professors"); Professor of Practice Emeritus (Mark McDermott) is emeritus. The Emeriti page lists 19 further emeriti who are not on the roster and are not required people.
Profile mentions an affiliate appointment in Chemistry; primary ECE professorship unaffected (regular). Similarly Millan has courtesy appointments elsewhere, ECE primary (regular).
